semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Aquatech provides water technology solutions that are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes, particularly in water reuse and zero liquid discharge systems.
summary: Aquatech Systems (Asia) Pvt. Ltd. specializes in advanced water technology solutions that address water scarcity and sustainability challenges in industrial sectors, including semiconductors. Their expertise in desalination, water reuse, and zero liquid discharge helps semiconductor manufacturers reduce their water and carbon footprints.
